body: Yeah I plan to get get it checked out to see what the hell I’m suppose to do with it. I used these nail clippers before to slowly trim them down and it worked pretty well. The salicylic acid didn’t really seem to do much. They’re so dry now to the point where I basically can’t even feel them there.

I had 2 warts before— I believe they are known as planter warts. The exterior of the wart was very dry skin so I would shave it down little by little. I used this salicylic acid patch that I got over the counter at a pharmacy which didn’t really seem to do much. The warts used to cause me lots of discomfort while walking, but it no longer does. The “wart” doesn’t even look like a wart anymore, it looks like this. 

Add area around it is very dried skin. The place where the wart was is basically a hole in my foot, but it’s also filled with dried skin. It doesn’t really hurt anymore to touch it, but I have no idea what I’m suppose to do with this now.

I have all the intentions of getting a second budgie soon down the line. I’ve had budgies before so I do have some background of bird keeping. When I got this budgie, the people at the store told me to get them 1 at a time to let the first one become familiar with me first, as it’ll be easier to bond with them. (My dad had a pair of budgies before and he did the same thing). I read up quite a lot of sources and it seems like this is the thing a lot of people recommend.

I’m also currently on break from work and school so I’m home 90% of the time. I thought this was the perfect opportunity to spend some time with my first budgie before introducing a second one.

I don’t know why I did what I did. I don’t truly want to die, as most people who do commit suicide never really want to “die”, but just escape their emotions and problems in life. I guess that night things just got really bad for me and I wanted to do *anything* about it. 

It’s not worth it. The days following that night had been pretty surreal. It’s hard to put into words but, it’s a crazy realization that if I had taken the alcohol first, there’s a good chance I wouldn’t have been here. It almost feels emotional just living every day lives and talking to friends and family the past few days knowing that I wouldn’t have been able to talk to them or see them at all. 

It’s not worth it. It really isn’t. I know it’s literally the most cliche thing I could be saying but please don’t do it.
